lavb.hint_in_corso: The selection is locked until the queue finishes (or you stop it): each row shows the status of its file, the bar at the bottom the overall picture. Stop interrupts a single file, Stop all the whole queue — everything can be resumed.
lavb.hint:
Select the files to process and check the model assigned to each one. The model is preselected based on the resolution.
Interrupted files, if selected, resume where they left off (with the same settings; changing them starts over).
lavb.chip_pausa_aiuto: The processes are frozen where they were: no GPU, no CPU. On resume they continue from exactly this point, and the time spent paused isn't counted in the file's duration.
lavb.chip_da_rifare_aiuto: The last job produced an incomplete file: the output was set aside as .PARZIALE instead of staying in OUTPUT under its proper name. If you run it again, the file is redone from scratch.
lavb.chip_fatto_spostato: The file was produced, but the output is no longer in OUTPUT: it was probably moved. Ticking it again redoes it from scratch.
lavb.chip_parametri_suoi_aiuto: Resumes with the settings it started with ({descr}), not the current ones in the sidebar. To redo it with new settings, discard the job.
lavb.scartata: Job discarded: the row is back to new.
lavb.riprendi_attesa: This file's analysis isn't ready yet: Resume becomes available as soon as the report arrives.
lavb.scarta_aiuto: Deletes the partial processing of THIS file (extracted frames, encoded chunks, state): the row goes back to new and the space is freed. Neither the source file nor any output in OUTPUT is touched.
lavb.scarta_residuo_aiuto: Deletes the work folder this file left in JOBS (extracted frames, encoded chunks, state) and frees the space. The finished output stays in OUTPUT, and the source file isn't touched.
lavb.residuo_scartato: Work folder deleted: the output in OUTPUT is untouched.
lavb.concluso_residuo: finished · output in OUTPUT; its work folder was left behind in JOBS, Discard frees the space
lavb.taratura_blocca: A calibration is running: Start processing and Resume stay locked until it finishes, so the two don't share the GPU.
lavb.riprese_aiuto: Processing completed in {riprese} runs; the total time includes the chunks in progress that were redone from the start after each interruption (up to ~{minuti} minutes each time).
lavb.nota_dedup_misurata: Dedup measured on this file: {quota} repeated frames. What remains is the usual gap between estimated and actual time.
lavb.nota_dedup: The actual duration depends on how many repeated frames are detected.
lavb.ferma_aiuto: Stops ONLY this file: processing can be resumed at any time. The other files in the launch carry on. To stop everything, use the button in the bar at the bottom.
lavb.interruzione_richiesta: Stop requested: the row will switch to "interrupted" in a few seconds.
lavb.coda_in_pausa: Queue paused between two jobs: the next one{posiz} starts at {ora}
lavb.rimanente_coda: Estimated time left for the whole queue: {quanto}
lavb.avvio_in_corso: Starting: analysing the selected files, which can take up to a minute with a large batch. Please be patient...
lavb.in_forse.uno:
{n} selected file has already been processed, but its output is no longer in OUTPUT: skipped for now:
{nomi}
lavb.in_forse.altri:
{n} selected files have already been processed, but their output is no longer in OUTPUT: skipped for now:
{nomi}
lavb.rifatti.uno:
{n} already processed file will be redone from scratch:
{nomi}
lavb.rifatti.altri:
{n} already processed files will be redone from scratch:
{nomi}
lavb.tempo_minimo: The minimum time applies when deduplication finds repeated frames, which are common in animation.
lavb.riprendi_tutto_aiuto: Wakes the job up exactly where it was: not a single frame is lost.
lavb.pausa_aiuto: Freezes the job where it is and frees up the CPU and graphics card. It resumes from exactly this point: no work lost, and the time spent paused isn't counted.
lavb.in_pausa: Paused. Resume from here whenever you like.
lavb.ferma_tutto_aiuto: Interrupts the file in progress (resumable) and cancels the remaining files in this launch.
lavb.lancio_interrotto: Launch stopped: the file in progress can still be resumed.
